name: @psyb0t/claudebox
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted claudebox (Claude Code on the network) instance over MCP.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running claudebox instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing its 5 tools: run_prompt (run a prompt through the containerized Claude Code CLI, with full file/shell/tool access to the workspace), list_files, read_file, write_file, and delete_file. claudebox is self-hosted — you run the container yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-claudebox.

CLAUDEBOX_URL.description: Base URL of your running claudebox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp). Requires CLAUDEBOX_API_MODE=1 and CLAUDEBOX_MCP_MODE=1 on the server.

CLAUDEBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, only if the claudebox server was started with CLAUDEBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN set.

url.description: Base URL of your running claudebox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token, only if the claudebox server was started with CLAUDEBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN set.
